label: experimental assumptions (author-selected), not the owner's trading preferences

thirtyMinuteBars.countedFrom: windows starting at or after the fill

target.primary: VAH + (VAH - VAL) of the prior completed session at the fill
target.ifEnteredAtOrAbove: lower edge of the highest-volume bin above the fill in the composite profile of the five completed sessions before the fill session; none if no bin lies above
target.activeFrom: the 5-minute bar after the fill bar

comparisons.name: AMT acceptance exit versus existing exits
AMT target exit versus existing exits
AMT acceptance exit versus price-only matched exit

statistic: S = T(first) - T(second), where T = net profit minus the run's exposure-matched hold's net profit

selection.rule: a development candidate is the first arm of a tested comparison whose S is positive and Holm-significant, with T > 0 at the base case and under every sensitivity, at least 30 completed trades, a drawdown of at most 15% and no stock above 40% of the gross gain; never called validated or proven profitable

reproduction: X1 must reproduce campaign 1's D-C base run to the cent before X2 to X4 run
